en.html: ...I seemed to have blacked out. One instant. Perhaps two. In that much time, the world had changed. First, my body. No strength anywhere. Knees on the ground, and lifting them was beyond me. Ichijou was nowhere in sight. Muramasa answered my will, turned her ears to searching...◆ There. About four kilometers east-northeast. Four kilometers. That far, she had apparently been thrown. The scanner was telling me so. Strange. Ordinary scanning sends a signal out, catches it returning from objects, and builds a picture from that. At ground level, too much clutter. Usually it does not work. Now it was working. Actually, nothing strange. Even at ground level, put yourself in the middle of a vast plain and the scanner works perfectly well. That much only.
en.text:
...I seemed to have blacked out.

One instant. Perhaps two.

In that much time, the world had changed.

First, my body. No strength anywhere. Knees on the ground, and lifting them was beyond me.

Ichijou was nowhere in sight. Muramasa answered my will, turned her ears to searching...◆

There. About four kilometers east-northeast.

Four kilometers.

That far, she had apparently been thrown.

The scanner was telling me so.

Strange. Ordinary scanning sends a signal out, catches it returning from objects, and builds a picture from that. At ground level, too much clutter. Usually it does not work.

Now it was working.

Actually, nothing strange. Even at ground level, put yourself in the middle of a vast plain and the scanner works perfectly well.

That much only.

ja.html: ……俺は、気を失ったらしい。 　おそらく……一瞬か二瞬のことだったと思う。 　その間に世界は変容していた。 　まず、俺の全身は萎えている。 　まるで力が入らない――地面に落ちた膝は全く持ち 上がらない。 　一条の姿は何処にも見当たらなかった。 　俺の意思に反応した村正が探査機能みみを働かせる……◆ いた。東北東に約四キロの地点。 　四キロ・・・。 　つまりはそれだけの距離を吹き飛ばされたらしい。 　……探査機能がそう伝えている。 　不思議なことだった。信号を発信、物体に衝突して 戻ってくるそれを受信することで状況掌握を行う通常 探査は、地上では物が多過ぎるためまず機能しない。 　それが機能する。 　実は、不思議でも何でもなかった。地上であっても、 それが大平原・・・のど真ん中であれば信号探査は支障なく 機能するのだ。それだけの事だ。

The whole world changed. Silver Star, unchanged.

Whatever it had done in that instant, no sign remained. Punch? Kick? Sword stroke? Without a trace to follow, how to know?

Perhaps nothing had moved at all. Perhaps it stood still because it had simply stayed still.

Perhaps all it had done was—◆get angry.

en.html:
The angry words went into my chest like blades. Deep enough that I almost tasted blood.

Why so deep? Why did they hurt so much? A killing monster saying whatever pleased it. Nothing more than that.

Ichijou and I, together, could prevent needless deaths. Overcome the curse that demanded innocent lives. Only those she judged evil would die. That girl, more sincere than anyone about what was right, more exacting than anyone.

Where was the wrong in that?

What reason was there to condemn it?

........................But.

Somewhere outside what I could put into thought, I must already have known the reason. Otherwise, why was I so shaken?

Hikaru"What are you saying? The weak should die. The strong should live."
Hikaru"Someone dying who should not die? No such person. They fell to your blade. They lost the contest of martial strength."
Hikaru"Good or evil, death follows from that. Perfectly reasonable. Where is the injustice?"
Kageaki"No...! Only evil that cannot be judged without death should die."
Kageaki"...And if Muramasa judges it, an innocent dies also. Under the Balance of Good and Evil..."
Kageaki"That... I cannot accept."
Hikaru"Kageaki. Kageaki."

I could not follow.

Could not stand. Could not even put out a hand.

My shattered soul would not send the smallest thread of strength to my limbs.
